itinerary.title: Arrival transfer from Cairo International Airport
itinerary.source: The first evening is light by design — a transfer from Cairo International Airport, a dinner, and the city left outside until the family is ready for it.

itinerary.title: Egyptian Museum, Citadel, Khan el-Khalili
itinerary.source: The day closes with an overnight train to Luxor, dinner served on board.

itinerary.title: Luxor: the West Bank
itinerary.source: The West Bank takes the first day.

itinerary.title: Karnak, then Hurghada on the Red Sea
itinerary.source: After Karnak, the itinerary turns east, leaving the Nile Valley for Hurghada on the Red Sea coast — the landscape shifting from cultivated green to open desert, then to the narrow coastal plain and the water.

itinerary.title: First Hurghada day: coral reef
itinerary.source: The Red Sea holds one of the finest coral reef systems on earth, and the first Hurghada day is the one to meet it.

itinerary.title: Second Hurghada day left open
itinerary.source: The second Hurghada day is deliberately left open.

itinerary.title: Fly to Cairo: Giza, Memphis, Saqqara
itinerary.source: You fly back to Cairo, and the final full day reaches back to the very beginning of the pyramid-building tradition — earlier, in fact, than the Giza plateau itself.

itinerary.title: Transfer to the airport
itinerary.source: The morning after, a transfer to the airport — and for families with later departures, additional arrangements can keep the final hours out of a hotel lobby.
